seo.title: Homeless and housing-crisis help in West Valley City - No Home Help
seo.description: Current West Valley City contacts for shelter, food, hygiene, health care, benefits, jobs, legal help and specialist support.

page.heading: Homeless and housing-crisis help in West Valley City
page.urgent: Immediate danger, serious injury, overdose, fire or a crime in progress: call 911. Mental-health or substance-use crisis: call or text 988. Shelter and current bed information: call 801-990-9999.
page.notice: Shelter capacity, winter overflow and service hours can change quickly. Call before travelling whenever possible. No listing guarantees a bed, room, housing, appointment, benefit, payment, treatment or job.
page.intro: Start with the local Switchpoint shelter and the county Homeless Services Line. Say who needs help, whether a partner, children or pet are with you, and any urgent health, safety or accessibility needs. If the local shelter is full or not suitable, ask for another Salt Lake County resource center and the safest transport route.
page.footer: No Home Help is independent of government and service providers. Information was checked against official provider or government pages; report a change if a number, address or access rule is no longer correct.

entries.title: 911 — emergency services
entries.description: Call for immediate danger, serious injury, suspected overdose, fire or a crime in progress. Give the exact address or nearest intersection and describe the immediate risk.
entries.how_to_access: Call 911. Do not use a shelter or crisis-line number instead when someone needs an ambulance, fire response or immediate police help.

entries.title: Salt Lake County Homeless Services Line
entries.description: Central contact for current bed information and intake or diversion at Salt Lake County homeless resource centers, including West Valley City. Capacity changes during the day and a call does not reserve a bed.
entries.address: Telephone access
entries.hours: Published staffed hours: daily 07:00–17:30; leave a voicemail if unanswered
entries.how_to_access: Call and explain household type, age, gender, pets and accessibility or safety needs. Ask for another appropriate center if the local option is full.

entries.title: Utah 211 — community-service referrals
entries.description: Statewide referral service for food, housing, health care, transportation, legal help, benefits and other local resources.
entries.address: Telephone and online service
entries.how_to_access: Call 211 or use the online directory. Ask the navigator to confirm eligibility, hours and whether an appointment is required.

entries.title: 988 Utah — mental-health and substance-use crisis
entries.description: Call or text for crisis counselling and connection to mobile response or a receiving center when appropriate. This is not a substitute for 911 during immediate physical danger.
entries.address: Telephone, text and online access
entries.how_to_access: Call or text 988 and explain your location and immediate need. Call 911 for a serious injury, overdose or immediate danger.

entries.title: Switchpoint West Valley City Homeless Resource Center
entries.description: Emergency shelter for single adult men and couples, with expanded capacity during qualifying winter Code Blue periods. It also provides food, hygiene and voluntary case-management support. Capacity is limited.
entries.address: 3381 S Redwood Road, West Valley City, UT 84119
entries.hours: Call or walk in; availability changes
entries.how_to_access: Call the Homeless Services Line before travelling or walk in. Ask about partner eligibility, pet rules, current check-in and a backup center if full.

entries.title: Salt Lake County resource centers — regional alternatives
entries.description: The county system includes separate adult men's, women's, all-gender, youth and family resource centers in Salt Lake City, South Salt Lake and Midvale. The correct destination depends on household type and available capacity.
entries.address: Locations assigned through the Homeless Services Line
entries.hours: Resource centers operate 24 hours; intake arrangements vary
entries.how_to_access: Call and ask which center is appropriate and available. Confirm the address and transport route; a referral does not guarantee a bed.

entries.title: South Valley Services — confidential domestic-violence shelter
entries.description: Safe shelter and support for adults and children affected by domestic or sexual violence. Services are available to people of all genders; the shelter location is confidential and capacity changes.
entries.address: Advocacy office: 2860 W 4700 S, Suite H, West Valley City, UT 84119; shelter location is confidential
entries.how_to_access: Call or text from a safe device. Ask about shelter, safety planning, transport and another safe option if no room is available.

entries.title: Housing Connect — affordable and subsidized housing
entries.description: Housing authority for West Valley City and Salt Lake County, including affordable properties and voucher programs. Waiting lists can be closed and this is not emergency shelter.
entries.address: 3595 S Main Street, Salt Lake City, UT 84115
entries.how_to_access: Check which waiting lists or properties are accepting applications. Keep contact information updated after applying and continue using emergency services while waiting.

entries.title: Utah Community Action — rent, deposit and homelessness help
entries.description: Eligibility-based rent or deposit assistance, landlord-tenant mediation, homelessness services and housing case management. Funds are limited and the program does not provide immediate guaranteed housing.
entries.address: Telephone and online intake for Salt Lake County
entries.how_to_access: Complete the online application or call intake. If facing a pay-or-vacate notice, say the deadline and ask about mediation at 801-214-3109.

entries.title: Utah Food Bank — pantry and mobile-food locator
entries.description: Official locator for food pantries and mobile distributions in and around West Valley City. Partner locations set their own schedules and eligibility rules.
entries.address: Use the official locator for the nearest site
entries.how_to_access: Search by address or ZIP code, then call the chosen site to confirm the next distribution and required documents.

entries.title: Crossroads Westside Food Pantry — regional groceries
entries.description: Emergency grocery support at a nearby west-side Salt Lake City location. This site provides food only and has service limits.
entries.address: 1358 W Indiana Avenue, Salt Lake City, UT 84104
entries.how_to_access: Call before travelling and ask about eligibility, frequency limits and required information.

entries.title: Utah Community Action — coordinated support
entries.description: Salt Lake County help with housing, utilities, Head Start, adult education, nutrition and employment support. Programs have separate eligibility and intake processes.
entries.address: Nearest full service hub: 5361 S 4220 W, Kearns, UT 84118
entries.hours: Call for program and hub hours
entries.how_to_access: Call intake, state your ZIP code and ask which nearby hub handles the service you need.

entries.title: Bishop Weigand Resource Center — regional showers and laundry
entries.description: Salt Lake City day center open to all, with showers, laundry, hygiene supplies, storage, case management and computers. It is a regional fallback, not an overnight bed.
entries.address: 437 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.how_to_access: Call before the journey, then complete intake on arrival. Ask UTA or a case manager about the safest transport route.

entries.title: Crossroads Thrift Store — clothing by referral or voucher
entries.description: Most donated clothing and household items are given away to people with a voucher from a Crossroads pantry or community partner. Stock and sizes vary.
entries.address: 1385 W Indiana Avenue, Salt Lake City, UT 84104
entries.how_to_access: Contact a Crossroads food pantry or community partner about a voucher, then confirm the store hours and item availability.

entries.title: Fourth Street Clinic — homeless health care
entries.description: Regional primary medical, dental, behavioural-health and pharmacy care for people experiencing homelessness. Walk-ins are accepted but same-day care is not guaranteed.
entries.address: 409 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.how_to_access: Call or walk in for triage and ask whether a mobile clinic is visiting a nearer service site. Call 911 for a life-threatening emergency.

entries.title: CommonSpirit Outpatient Behavioral Health West Valley
entries.description: Outpatient medication management and individual, family and group therapy. Insurance and fees vary; this is not a free crisis shelter or emergency department.
entries.address: 3336 S Pioneer Parkway, Suite 202A, West Valley City, UT 84120
entries.how_to_access: Call for an appointment and ask about insurance or self-pay cost. Use 988 for immediate crisis support.

entries.title: 988 Utah — crisis counselling and mobile response
entries.description: Immediate support for suicide, mental-health or substance-use crises, with connection to mobile response or a receiving center when appropriate.
entries.address: Telephone, text and online access
entries.how_to_access: Call or text 988. Call 911 for immediate danger, serious injury or overdose.

entries.title: Valley Behavioral Health — access and outpatient services
entries.description: Public behavioural-health provider for Salt Lake County. Adult walk-in intake is at its Salt Lake City access clinic; a West Valley clinic serves children, youth and families. Insurance and program eligibility vary.
entries.address: Children, youth and family clinic: 3725 S 4100 W, Suite 200, West Valley City, UT 84120
entries.hours: Youth and family walk-in hours vary; call before visiting
entries.how_to_access: Call the access line, state the age and need, and ask which clinic and intake time applies. Use 988 for an immediate crisis.

entries.title: West Valley Library — public indoor space
entries.description: Public library with toilets, seating, information help, computers and free internet. Library rules apply and it is not an overnight shelter.
entries.address: 2880 W 3650 S, West Valley City, UT 84119
entries.how_to_access: Walk in during opening hours. Ask staff about a guest computer session and local service information.

entries.title: West Valley Library — computers and free internet
entries.description: Public computers and free internet access, with printing and information help. Session limits and printing charges may apply.
entries.address: 2880 W 3650 S, West Valley City, UT 84119
entries.how_to_access: Ask staff for a guest computer session, Wi-Fi or charging. Protect passwords and personal information on public devices.

entries.title: UTA Reduced Fare FAREPAY Card
entries.description: Reduced fares for qualifying low-income riders, people with disabilities, seniors and youth. Approval and identity or eligibility evidence are required.
entries.address: Nearest customer service: Meadowbrook, 3600 S 700 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84119
entries.how_to_access: Apply online or at customer service. Ask a shelter or Utah Community Action case manager for help with eligibility evidence.

entries.title: Utah Workforce Services — SNAP, medical and cash assistance
entries.description: Applications and eligibility support for SNAP, medical, financial and child-care assistance. Approval depends on program rules.
entries.address: Apply online, by telephone or at a Workforce Services employment center
entries.how_to_access: Apply through myCase, by telephone or in person. The initial SNAP application can be submitted before every verification document is available.

entries.title: Utah Workforce Services — job and training help
entries.description: Job search, employment counselling and possible training or education support for eligible jobseekers. Services do not guarantee a job.
entries.address: Use the official locator for the nearest employment center
entries.how_to_access: Apply online or visit an employment center. Ask for help creating an online account if internet access or identification is a barrier.

entries.title: Utah Community Action — workforce development
entries.description: Employment support and connections to training for eligible Salt Lake County residents. Program openings and requirements vary.
entries.address: Telephone intake and service hubs
entries.how_to_access: Call and request a workforce-development appointment or email the program through the official site.

entries.title: Utah Legal Services — civil legal aid
entries.description: Free civil legal help for eligible low-income Utah residents, including some housing, public-benefit, family and consumer matters. Representation is not guaranteed.
entries.address: 960 S Main Street, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
entries.how_to_access: Apply online or call intake before visiting. Explain any eviction, hearing or filing deadline immediately.

entries.title: West Valley City Victim Services
entries.description: City advocates help crime victims understand rights, obtain referrals, prepare for court and seek protective orders. This is not a shelter or emergency response service.
entries.address: Public Safety Building, 3636 S Constitution Boulevard, West Valley City, UT 84119
entries.how_to_access: Contact the office for an advocate. Call 911 for immediate danger and the South Valley helpline for confidential shelter.

entries.title: South Valley Services — 24-hour helpline and shelter
entries.description: Confidential crisis support, safe shelter, advocacy, therapy and housing support for adults and children affected by domestic or sexual violence.
entries.address: Advocacy office: 2860 W 4700 S, Suite H, West Valley City, UT 84119; shelter location is confidential
entries.how_to_access: Call or text from a safe device. Ask about shelter, safe transport and another option if full. Call 911 for immediate danger.

entries.title: West Valley City — victim advocates
entries.description: Local advocacy for victims of crime, including domestic violence, with court support, protective-order information and referrals.
entries.address: Public Safety Building, 3636 S Constitution Boulevard, West Valley City, UT 84119
entries.how_to_access: Contact Victim Services for non-emergency support. For confidential shelter use the South Valley helpline; for immediate danger call 911.

entries.title: Volunteers of America Utah — homeless outreach team
entries.description: Mobile outreach across the Salt Lake area, connecting unsheltered people to basic needs, behavioural-health care, shelter and housing services.
entries.address: Mobile outreach in Salt Lake County
entries.how_to_access: Call and give a clear location and immediate needs. Call 911 instead for immediate danger or a medical emergency.

entries.title: VA Salt Lake City — homeless veteran care
entries.description: Help for veterans who are homeless or at risk, including shelter and housing referrals, health care, benefits, employment support and justice-system re-entry.
entries.address: Regional and telephone service
entries.hours: Local extension 2746; national homeless-veteran line 877-424-3838 is available 24 hours
entries.how_to_access: Call extension 2746 or the national line. You do not need to prove eligibility before making the first call.

entries.title: Switchpoint West Valley — some animals accepted
entries.description: The official 211 listing states that the shelter accepts some animals. Acceptance depends on capacity, animal behaviour and current shelter rules.
entries.address: 3381 S Redwood Road, West Valley City, UT 84119
entries.how_to_access: Tell staff the animal's type, size and needs before travelling. Ask what records or supplies are required and request a backup pet-care option if the shelter cannot accept the animal.

entries.title: Ruff Haven — temporary pet crisis sheltering
entries.description: Short-term shelter or foster care for dogs and cats when an owner faces a qualifying crisis. Space and eligibility are assessed and acceptance is not guaranteed.
entries.address: Salt Lake City area; intake arranged after approval
entries.how_to_access: Complete the official application or ask a shelter case manager for help applying.

entries.title: West Valley City — affordable-housing information
entries.description: City explanation of Housing Connect and local affordable-housing programs. It is not an emergency placement service.
entries.address: Online resource
entries.how_to_access: Review current contacts and then ask Housing Connect which waiting lists or properties are accepting applications.
